general_information.Syllabus Name: Housekeeping Management (Pratice)_Quản trị buồng phòng (Thực hành)
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (50h) = 22,5h (30 sessions) contact hours 27,5h self-study
general_information.Description: Main objective: This course aims to equip students with the skills to manage resources, administer assets and familiar with several key procedures of housekeeping cleanliness process. -Description: This course focus on practicing house keeping procedure. -Teaching method: ldemonstration, roleplay
general_information.StudentTasks: Attend 100% of class hours in order to obtain the completion criteria. - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Comply with the time and regulation - Professional grooming - Respect and protect school asset. - Strongly communication and teamworking.
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.

description: Main objective: This course aims to equip students with the skills to manage resources, administer assets and familiar with several key procedures of housekeeping cleanliness process. -Description: This course focus on practicing house keeping procedure. -Teaching method: ldemonstration, roleplay

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To operate the key procedure of cleaning and inspecting guest rooms, public areas and others, as well as able to demonstrate a working knowledge of the procedures.
To utilize various techniques to manage inventories effectively
To operate the method of protecting property from damage and risk of insect
To demonstrate highly cooperation and discipline the team, instructor and school regulation
To communicate english fluently and professtionally in working place

assessments.CLO: PT 1: CLO1, CLO4, CLO5 PT 2: CLO1, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5
assessments.No Question: Each student shoud make at least 1 individual performance
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Practical test 1: Chapter 5- Characteristics of Housekeeping Equipment and Supplies Chapter 7 -The Cleaning Function Practical test 2: Chapter 6-Laundry Room Management Chapter 10- Safety, Security and Infectious Diseases in Property Operations
assessments.Grading Guide: Practical test 1: Guest room cleaning procedure Bathroom cleaning procedure Funiture arrangement and room decoration Guest in-house room cleaning procedure Embellishment service Practical test 2: Handling laundry and dry cleaning procedure Stains treatment and removal procedure Dealing with harmful organisms procedure Public area clealiness procedure
assessments.Note: Students can perform a task in group of 2 or more, but grade will be given individually

assessments.Grading Guide: Students must attend 100% of contact slots Attendance check at any time during course
